about_the_game:
After a thousand years of slumber, the world is no longer the same. Humanity has changed, civilizations have fallen… yet Easter Island remains silent.

Enjoying your retirement on this quiet island, all you have to do is keep clicking and harvesting dozens of crop varieties.

🌾 Let the ancient vampire’s night harvest begin! 🌛🦇

🌱 Basic Tips & Features

  • Unlocking more tiles gives you access to new crop varieties.

  • Clicking boosts watering, fertilizing, harvesting, and movement speed.

  • Increasing your stamina lets you work longer in the field. (Stamina refills when you sleep.)

  • Fertilizer helps your crops grow 2x faster.

  • Protector bats keep your crops safe from pests.

  • Upgrading your inventory lets you carry more crops to the market, allowing you to earn more points.

    Sit back and enjoy discovering 55+ crop varieties.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.1 ghz or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2nd Generation Intel Core HD Graphics (2000/3000), 512MB
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: A relaxing idle game where you harvest dozens of varieties of crops on the side of your screen.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Finnish, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
